input.summary: Use the upper-right Bomb bank as a bank-shot route into the right chute for 10x bonus, build the upper-left saucer to 50,000 through the spinner, then exploit the ten-second 1,000-point bumper and spinner window after either major collect.

quickInfo.name: Right chute
quickInfo.summary: The chute multiplies bonus by ten, turning a base bonus of up to 10,000 into as much as 100,000.

quickInfo.name: Bank-shot route
quickInfo.summary: There is no direct chute shot; the intended route is a left-flipper bank off the Bomb targets and a bumper.

quickInfo.name: Saucer value
quickInfo.summary: Spinner action raises the upper-left saucer value as high as 50,000.

quickInfo.name: Ten-second boost
quickInfo.summary: A chute or saucer collect makes the bumpers and spinner score 1,000 instead of 100 for ten seconds.

quickInfo.name: Bomb bank
quickInfo.summary: The first completion is modest, but each Bomb target is worth 10,000 on the second bank.

steps.text: Plunge through the seven top tabs and nudge for additional 5,000-point tabs before the ball exits.
Use safe spinner passes to raise the upper-left saucer toward 50,000.
From the left flipper, bank the ball into the upper-right Bomb targets.
Watch for a Bomb-target rebound into a bumper and then the right chute.
After the chute scores, use the ten-second 1,000-point bumper and spinner window instead of forcing a lower shot.
Continue Bomb-bank attempts until the second-bank targets are worth 10,000 each.
Collect the upper-left saucer after its spinner-built value reaches 50,000.
Protect the multiplied end-of-ball bonus and stop shooting a bank angle that repeatedly enters a slingshot.

fallback.title: Top-tab bonus build
fallback.when: Use this plan when the Bomb-bank rebound will not enter the right chute safely.

steps.text: Feed the ball above the bumpers by the safer available route.
Nudge among the seven top tabs to build base bonus.
Use spinner passes to raise the saucer value.
Collect the upper-left saucer only from a controlled feed.
Resume the chute plan only after a natural rebound demonstrates the correct angle.

alternatives.title: 50,000 saucer route
alternatives.when: Use this plan when the spinner is repeatable but the right chute remains inaccessible.

steps.text: Repeat the spinner while its return is controlled.
Use spinner passes to raise the upper-left saucer value to 50,000.
Shoot the saucer from the flipper that presents the cleanest angle.
Use the resulting ten-second bumper and spinner boost.
Return to top tabs and spinner building after the boost ends.
Roll over the seven top tabs to advance base bonus.
Bank the Bomb targets until a rebound reaches the right chute.
Secure the chute's 10x end-of-ball bonus value.
Use spinner passes to raise the upper-left saucer to 50,000.
Collect the saucer and harvest safe bumper or spinner action during the ten-second boost.

techniques.name: Bomb-bank angle
techniques.instruction: From the left flipper, aim into the face of the upper-right Bomb bank so the rebound continues upward toward a bumper rather than straight down the middle.

techniques.name: Top-rubber nudge
techniques.instruction: While the ball is among the top rubbers, use small early nudges to cross extra rollover tabs before it falls below the area.

techniques.name: Corner-post recovery
techniques.instruction: Observe how an outlane-bound ball contacts the lower corner mini post. Reproduce only the small nudge that previously redirected it into the return lane.

cautions.issue: Most imperfect upper returns approach a slingshot or the inlane-outlane divider.
cautions.response: Prepare to nudge before the ball reaches the divider, and do not wait for the outlane decision point.

cautions.issue: Repeated Bomb-bank attempts can send hard rebounds toward the center.
cautions.response: Abandon an angle that misses its bumper path twice and build through the top or spinner instead.

cautions.issue: The lower corner mini posts may be removed or positioned differently for competition.
cautions.response: Inspect both corners before play. Never depend on a recovery that this machine cannot provide.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm the four-player 1977 Zaccaria Combat, ball count, Bonus Ball and Special conversion, tilt, and tournament scoring.
Confirm that the right chute registers 10x bonus and the temporary bumper and spinner lamps score 1,000 for ten seconds.
Test the lower mini posts, Bomb-bank rebounds, spinner, upper-left saucer eject, and right-chute registration before choosing the route.

playfieldReferences.description: Bank used for qualification and scoring.

input.simpleOverview: Combat awards 10x bonus at the right chute and raises the upper-left saucer through spinner passes. Use a left-flipper bank off the Bomb targets to reach the chute, or repeat the spinner until the saucer reaches 50,000; either collect starts ten seconds of 1,000-point bumpers and spinner scoring.
input.overview: Combat raises its upper-left saucer through spinner passes and awards 10x bonus at the bank-shot right chute. Use safe spinner passes to raise the saucer, or bank off the upper-right targets when the chute feed is proven. After either major collect, exploit the ten-second 1,000-point bumper and spinner window before returning to setup shots.
